name: Tawakkul (Trust in Allah)

definition_by_age.4: Allah takes care of us always.
definition_by_age.6: Trusting Allah means doing your best and then feeling calm about what happens next.
definition_by_age.8: Tawakkul means relying on Allah with full confidence after you've done everything within your own effort and ability.

common_misconceptions: Tawakkul means doing nothing and just waiting — wrong: you must still try your best first (see the consultation dua and Quran 3:159).
learning_objective: Children can say a trust-in-Allah dua after trying their best at something hard.

recommended_default.note: Retrieval ranking (retrieval_ranking.md) starts from this combination and diversity-penalizes away from it on repeat use, per recommended_story_combinations.md.

qv_004.reasoning: Directly commands trust in Allah after deciding.

qv_005.reasoning: Yunus's dua of trust in hardship.

dua_006.reasoning: Directly the dua said in extreme hardship, trusting Allah.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: Fear of the dark fits fear->step->support->confidence, trust-in-Allah flavored.
A rainy day changing plans fits natural-consequence acceptance.
